Maya (CSM): Quick alert Orbit Analytics usage fell ~62% over 30d, primary contact left, procurement testing CompetitorX. Need renewal-risk sprint.
Ravi (Solutions): Can you drop the top endpoints and any recent errors? cc @Luis for playbook.
Tori (AE): I'm looped in. I have the proposal notes and their pending RFP items. Out until EOD but monitoring.
Maya (CSM): Plan suggestion: 24h telemetry check, 48h outreach combo (AE+CSM), offer 7-day stability credit + migration assist. Thoughts?
Luis (RevOps): Risk score 6.5/10. Send me the contract window and renewal horizon; I'll prep the reactivation email and a short ROI snapshot.
Ravi (Solutions): Running quick query now. If CompetitorX is model-only, our edge is per-route caching and predictable token costs I'll prep a 1-pager.
infra-bot: Ticket CS-6201 created for Orbit Analytics - "usage dip & competitor trial" assigned to Maya.
Maya (CSM): Please paste the top-3 endpoints and any config changes here. Tori can you intro the new PM?
Tori (AE): Intro sent to jamie@orbit.io. Proposed 30m: Thu 9/12 11am PT.
Ravi (Solutions): Posted telemetry to CS-6201: /generate down 58%, /summarize down 70%, /embed down 45%. No infra changes in 30d.
Maya (CSM): Great. Booking the call. We'll open with a short technical triage (Ravi 10m), then discuss pilot terms and stability credit. Update CS-6201 after the meeting. :thumbsup:
